method: 288 synchronized finish/readback renders,960x640,DPR1;three profiles,four scenes,two frozen source versions,three alternating rounds,four measured samples per round after warmup. Exact cameras,date,sun,wind and common weather asserted equal. Only this browser/GPU workload during measurement. SwiftShader software; no physical GPU/Android/FPS claim. WebGL allocations are logical estimates, not measured physical VRAM.

alloc.method: Instrumented WebGL2 bufferData/deleteBuffer and texture storage/mipmap/delete calls. Logical storage, texture estimate with depth24 conservatively counted as 4 B/texel. Excludes driver/compression/framebuffer defaults; not physical VRAM.
